about_the_game:
Aliens are attacking the world! Only the Xeno Strikers Hyper Squadron can repel their attack! Are you the pilot who will kick the invading forces out of the solar system?

6 weapons to unlock and upgrade:

  • Blaster - Shoots projectiles straight ahead! Can be upgraded to shoot twice, to pierce enemy shields, and to slow enemies!

  • Burst - Rapid fire machine gun! Can be upgraded to fire massive waves and stun enemies!

  • Laser - Instantly zaps the closest enemy! Can be upgraded to chain zap several enemies and set them on fire!

  • Spheres - Plasma spheres orbit the player ship! Can be upgraded to stun enemies and to knock enemies out of the skies one after another!

  • Pulse - A powerful shockwave pulsating from the player ship! It can be upgraded to cover a massive area and to slow enemies down!

  • Missiles - Launches from the side of the player ship! Can be upgraded to deal splash damage, stun, and set enemies on fire!

The game features 5 stages with increasingly difficult enemies, each with a separate theme:

  • Forest - The easiest enemies seem to be lost in the forest! Help them find their way out -- from the world!

  • Ice - Aliens may be cool, but are they cool enough to withstand the frozen tundra?

  • Desert - Too hot and inhospitable for most, but aliens still found their way here!

  • Tropical - Usually, it's better to go to these tropical islands for a vacation, but today, there's work to be done!

  • City - The final stand against the aliens, where the most powerful enemies are congregating! If the city falls, the world is doomed!

Choose from 9 different captains that start with varying upgrades. 8 must be unlocked by playing the game!

12 difficulty levels that are progressively unlocked! Surely, only the best captains can beat all of them!

And last, but definitely not least, a banging soundtrack inspired by classic 90s video games!

short_description: A roguelike top-down shoot-em-up! Defeat waves of enemies and level up your ship and arsenal as you move from world to world! Challenge yourself with 12 different difficulties, from a breeze in the park to tough as nails!
